## What changed

Describe the change and its purpose. Link the issue if there was a discussion.

## Evidence and applicability

For a technical change, list the printer model, conditions, sources and confirmed outcomes. A new article requires independent repeated cases. For an editorial change, state whether the technical meaning is unchanged.

## Validation

- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and the contribution licensing terms.
- [ ] No raw archive, local skills, secrets or other people's personal data are included.
- [ ] Applicability, limitations, warnings and evidence links are preserved.
- [ ] For a new article, content-manifest.json is updated; the build, links and search are checked.

State any checks not run and any claims that still lack evidence.
